dedupe_keys.name: real time co2 emissions and power by fuel at 3 minute interval finland and neighbours 2013 2021

description: This data set gives power generation split by fuel and the related carbon dioxide emissions, calculated on both a production and a consumption basis, at a three-minute interval from January 2013 to October 2021. It was published on Zenodo in November 2021 (version 1.0) by Jean-Nicolas Louis as the historical archive of a real-time emissions project, whose API serves current values. Yearly files hold power by fuel and emissions under alternative accounting assumptions. Coverage is Finland, Sweden, Norway, Russia and Estonia. Files are MATLAB .mat files of roughly 150 to 200 MB per year, downloadable from Zenodo under CC BY 4.0 at no cost. Caveats: the files need MATLAB or a compatible reader, the documentation is brief, and the archive stops in October 2021. Simulation uses are emission-aware demand response and scheduling, carbon accounting of electricity use and validating power system models of the Nordic and Baltic region. Related records: data-csiro-nem-consumption-emissions-intensity is a similar consumption-based emissions series for Australia.
